title: mymind pill button
description: Fully rounded buttons in a soft rounded sans: a solid tangerine pill (plain or small capitals), and a quiet grey-tinted app pill with an icon whose text turns tangerine on hover with a long expo-out ease.
notes: uses the theme's --mymind-round face when set, else the body face
name: mymind-pill

props.name: variant
props.description: "solid": the tangerine call to action; "soft": the pale app-store style pill

props.name: size
props.description: sm: 36px (header, small capitals); md: 46px; lg: 50px app pills

props.name: caps
props.description: set the label in small spaced capitals

props.name: trailing
props.description: an icon after the label (e.g. a chevron)
